mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_message ( conversation_id, sender_type, message_type, content, response_time, extra_info, send_time, is_deleted ) VALUES ( #{conversationId}, #{senderType}, #{messageType}, #{content}, #{responseTime}, #{extraInfo}, #{sendTime}, #{isDeleted} )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_message WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY send_time ASC
